text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
At long last, Symboli Rudolf's racing<n>debut is upon
us.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Despite the early hour, the venue is<n>electric. The
atmosphere feels more<n>like a graded race than a
simple<n>debut.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hah! The race hasn't even begun,<n>and I can feel
the crowd's excitement<n>from here.
choice_data_list: You're the one they're waiting for.
You're the one they're waiting for.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. All eyes are on me, perhaps<n>more now
than there ever will be.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Only today are they free to wonder<n>how I measure
up to the title of<n>Emperor. Once I take to the track,
I'll<n>become a known quantity.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That means my performance today is<n>crucial.
Anything less than the best<n>will disappoint them.
choice_data_list: That sounds like a lot of pressure.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Surely you know better than that.<n>Who do you take
me for?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: If anything, I see this as an<n>opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If the crowd is this excited before<n>they've even
seen me run, imagine<n>the fame we'll enjoy if I
account for<n>myself well.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
So, worry not. Or rather, I should say...<n>I will not let
you down.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Today we take the first step on our<n>road of
conquest.
